config.description: Method replication: the images are new Baidu street views of central Hengyang, not the paper's stimuli. Raters from relevant fields score each street view on the six dimensions of the living-street quality evaluation system (convenience, functionality, safety, comfort, sociality, visuality) from 1 (low quality) to 5 (high quality), the subjective check used by Duan, Liao, Liu, Gao, Shang & Huang (2023, Sustainability) to validate their image-based quality score. The paper's six volunteers agreed on the rules in a seminar before scoring 105 views taken 500 m apart. Differences from the original study: 30 random views per rater; a short note on each dimension is shown instead of the seminar.

paper.title: Evaluating the Spatial Quality of Urban Living Streets: A Case Study of Hengyang City in Central South China
